arch: LSTM(48) + GaussianNoise + Dropout, 4-class softmax (same as v2 lstm_s)

provenance.base: CIC-IDS2017 RAW pcap (Kaggle congyuanxu/cicids2017), re-extracted with OUR nfstream config so features match the live sensor. ~1.5M flows. Labelled timezone-free by IP+port (attacker 172.16.0.1 -> victim 192.168.10.50; Tue 21/22=BruteForce, Wed 80=DoS, Fri 80=DDoS). Tools: Hulk/GoldenEye/Slowloris/Slowhttptest, LOIC, FTP-/SSH-Patator.
provenance.finetune: fine-tuned on own-LAN lab captures (42 nfstream captures, benign variety + DoS/DDoS/BF tools)

evaluation.unseen_tool_cv: leave-one-attack-tool-out: DoS unseen ~1.0 for most tools (synflood/httpflood/slowloris/siege/ab 0.8-1.0; low-concurrency dos_siege/dos_abflood weak); DDoS/BruteForce unseen limited (few tool variants in data)

best_flow_v2 (CICFlowMeter) on nfstream.note: near-blind on real nfstream traffic -> why this model replaces it for serving

lab_only_model.note: matched sensor but tiny data, poor unseen-tool

limitations: low-concurrency siege/ab DoS is ambiguous (looks like heavy-but-benign) -> dos_siege recall ~0
DDoS/BruteForce unseen-tool generalization limited by few tool variants
lab data is one VM/netns environment; a real deployment LAN should capture its own benign+attack
EDA macroF1 figures are on full (incl train) data = illustrative; honest numbers are the held-out splits above
